logline: When the Constable attempts to arrest Alexander for grand theft, Clarissa offers Juliana a sadistic ultimatum: retrieve a signet ring from frozen, razor-sharp blackthorn briars with her bare hands, or watch her husband hang.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 11's cliffhanger where the Constable pulls Gerald's planted gold pocket watch from Alexander's trench coat.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the Constable raising a set of heavy iron handcuffs, addressing Alexander sternly in front of the stone hearth.

events.label: CONSTABLE (Authoritative, Stern)
events.content: "Put out your hands, veteran. You are under arrest for theft."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana swiftly moving in front of Alexander, placing herself defiantly between him and the Constable's outstretched handcuffs.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana steps firmly forward, shielding Alexander with her body.

events.label: JULIANA (Furious, Defiant)
events.content: "No! That watch was not in his coat!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Constable narrowing his eyes coldly at Juliana.

events.label: CONSTABLE (Blunt, Unyielding)
events.content: "I found it there myself."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana glaring back with unwavering conviction.

events.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Accusatory)
events.content: "Then someone put it there!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium full shot of Gerald framed in the open cottage doorway holding his riding crop, stepping inside with a patronizing, gloating grin.

events.label: GERALD (Smug, Condescending)
events.content: "The proof is in his coat, Juliana. A valuable pocket watch doesn't just walk into a beggar's pocket."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander, his scarred brow furrowed in dark, quiet defiance.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Steady, Dangerous)
events.content: "I have never touched your property."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Gerald pointing his riding crop toward them, with Clarissa hovering behind him in her violet silk gown.

events.label: GERALD (Mocking, Malicious)
events.content: "Then perhaps your wife should explain why it was found in your coat."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.

events.label: JULIANA (Enraged, Shouting)
events.content: "You planted it!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Clarissa gliding past Gerald, a venomous, amused smile playing upon her lips.

events.label: CLARISSA (Purring, Taunting)
events.content: "Oh, dear sister..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight shot of Alexander's hand clenching into a tight, trembling fist against the glow of the roaring fireplace.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander glaring daggers at Clarissa.

events.label: CLARISSA (O.S.) (Continuing taunt)
events.content: "...still defending your broken scrap of a man?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes narrowing with sharp perception.

events.label: JULIANA (Steely, Resolute)
events.content: "Name your price, Clarissa. I know you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Clarissa smiling with vicious delight.

events.label: CLARISSA (Smooth, Derisive)
events.content: "You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight shot of Clarissa smoothing her long purple evening glove along her wrist.

events.label: CLARISSA (Scheming)
events.content: "Perhaps I can give you one."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana watching her with cautious skepticism.

events.label: JULIANA (Guarded, Cold)
events.content: "What do you want?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot of Clarissa in the foreground, turning slowly to face Juliana.

events.label: CLARISSA (Cruel, Savoring)
events.content: "I want to see you crawl, sister."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up profile tracking shot of Clarissa pacing slowly as she spins her sadistic tale.

events.label: CLARISSA (Theatrical, Vindictive)
events.content: "My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Clarissa flexing her gloved fingers theatrically in front of her face.

events.label: CLARISSA (Chilling, Sarcastic)
events.content: "...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot of Clarissa stepping closer to Juliana, peering down into her eyes with a predatory smile.

events.label: CLARISSA (Demanding, Brutal)
events.content: "You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Gerald tapping his whip against his palm and laughing heartily beside the Constable.

events.label: GERALD (Gleeful, Derisive)
events.content: "A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium three-shot of Clarissa stepping behind Juliana, as Alexander watches helplessly with dark fury.

events.label: CLARISSA (Cold, Transactional)
events.content: "Do it, and we withdraw the charges."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of Clarissa's mouth leaning directly into Juliana's ear, whispering venomously.

events.label: CLARISSA (Whispering, Menacing)
events.content: "Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Alexander stepping up beside Juliana, tenderly placing his large hand on her shoulder.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Desperate, Protective, Urgent)
events.content: "Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, her hand gripping the fabric over her heart in agony and resolve.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.

events.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Emotional, Sacrificial)
events.content: "I am not letting them take you."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana turns her head sharply back toward Clarissa, her expression hardening with fierce resolution.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Over-the-shoulder shot past Clarissa onto Juliana's determined face, holding on her fierce, defiant stare as the tension peaks.

events.label: JULIANA (Steely, Resolute)
events.content: "Tell me where the garden is."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa without flinching as the scene freezes on her brave, sacrificial defiance.

analysis_metadata.note: No invented LLM scene metadata; event-level evidence drives promo selection.
